Overview.Name: Kotaiah Boyapati
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Feeling energetic & confident, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Minimal non-veg, mostly vegetarian; non-veg at lunch

Early_Morning (optional): Option 1: Warm water (200 ml) + lemon water
Option 2: Warm water (200 ml) + soaked almonds (6 nos)
Option 3: Warm water (200 ml) + fruit (100 g)
Breakfast: Option 1: Oats porridge (150 g) with nuts (15 g)
Option 2: Vegetable upma (80 g) + curd (100 g)
Lunch: Option 1: Plain rice (150 g) + chicken curry (200 g) + dal (100 g) + veg (100 g)
Option 2: Plain rice (150 g) + egg curry (3 eggs) + dal (100 g) + veg (100 g)
Option 3: Plain rice (150 g) + paneer curry (150 g) + dal (100 g)
Evening_Snack: Option 1: Roasted makhana (30 g) + green tea (200 ml)
Option 2: Fruit (100 g) + handful of nuts (20 g)
Dinner: Option 1: Dal (180 g) + vegetable curry (120 g) + salad (50 g)
Option 3: Light vegetable soup (250 ml) + millet roti (2 small)

Notes_and_Tips: For thyroid: monitor metabolism and avoid crash diets.
Include protein (eggs, chicken, paneer) for satiety and muscle support.
Control portion sizes of rice and fried foods.
Prefer grilled or boiled non-veg rather than fried.
Aim for regular mild exercise like walking to support weight loss.
Avoid late-night heavy meals; keep dinner light.
